scanNote: Skanda 7-mashqning 1-bandiga oldingi o'quvchining qo'lyozma javobi bor: 'them' va 'they'. Ikkalasi ham xato — bu 'Ko'p uchraydigan xato' bo'limida tushuntirilgan.

exercises.instructionEn: Fill in the gaps with: he, she, they, them, him, it, I.
exercises.instructionUz: Bo'shliqlarni to'ldiring: he, she, they, them, him, it, I.
exercises.explanationUz:
HAR BIR BANDDA TO'RT BO'SHLIQ.
Joyiga qarab EGA yoki OBYEKT shakli kerak:

  ____ likes ____ a lot.
   ↑ ega        ↑ obyekt (fe'ldan keyin)

  ____ thinks ____ 's interesting.
   ↑ ega         ↑ ega (chunki keyin fe'l 'is' keladi)

MUHIM: uchinchi va to'rtinchi bo'shliqlar IKKALASI HAM ega —
chunki ikkinchisidan keyin 'is/are' fe'li keladi:
  She thinks HE'S interesting.  (he is)
  They think IT'S terrible.     (it is)

KIM HAQIDA GAPIRILYAPTI:
  savoldagi EGA → javobdagi 1 va 3-bo'shliq
  savoldagi TO'LDIRUVCHI → javobdagi 2 va 4-bo'shliq

commonMistake.whatUz: Skandagi oldingi o'quvchi 1-bandda 'THEM likes THEY a lot' deb yozgan.
commonMistake.whyUz:
IKKI XATO:
1) 'them' — OBYEKT shakli, u fe'ldan OLDIN turolmaydi. Ega shakli kerak.
2) 'they' — EGA shakli, u fe'ldan KEYIN turolmaydi. Obyekt shakli kerak.
Har ikkalasi TESKARI qo'yilgan.
To'g'ri javob: 'SHE likes HIM a lot' — Kate (ayol) → she, George (erkak) → him.
Qoida: fe'ldan OLDIN — ega (he, she, they, I), fe'ldan KEYIN — obyekt (him, her, them, me).

lines.whyUz: Keyt fe'ldan oldin → EGA 'She'. Jorj fe'ldan keyin → OBYEKT 'him'.
'She thinks' — ega. 'he's interesting' = he IS — bu ham ega, chunki keyin fe'l keladi.

lines.textEn: Do your grandparents like pop music?

lines.whyUz: 'grandparents' ko'plik → They. 'pop music' — narsa → it. 'not ... at all' = umuman ...emas.
'They think' — ega. 'it's terrible' = it IS — ega. 'terrible' = dahshatli, juda yomon.

lines.hintUz: Javob beruvchi o'zi haqida; Tomning akasi — erkak
lines.whyUz: 'Do you ...?' → 'I don't ...'. 'Tom's brother' erkak, fe'ldan keyin → him.
'I think' — ega. 'he's rude' = he IS — ega.

lines.textEn: Does your sister like romantic films?

lines.whyUz: 'sister' ayol → She. 'romantic films' ko'plik, fe'ldan keyin → them.

lines.hintUz: Ikkalasi ham fe'ldan oldin; ikkinchisi ko'plik
lines.whyUz: 'She thinks' — ega. 'they're great' = they ARE — ega, ko'plik.

exercises.explanationUz:
PREDLOGLAR — bu betdagi hamma turlari:

  VAQT:
    ON + kun:        on Sunday evening, on Sundays
    IN + davr:       in my free time, in the afternoon

  JOY:
    ON + coast:      on the south coast
    IN + shahar/uy:  in a big house, in the north of England
    AT + muassasa:   at Memorial Hospital
    FROM + masofa:   about fifteen minutes' walk from the centre

  BOSHQA:
    WITH + tavsif:   tall with brown hair
    TO + listen:     listening to rock music
    ABOUT + mavzu:   that's all about me
    OF + qism:       four of us, the north of England
    FOR + ish joyi:  works for a company

UCHTA ENG MUHIM FARQ:
  in the north OF England  — mamlakat qismi
  on the ... coast OF England — qirg'oq
  at Memorial Hospital     — aniq muassasa nomi

items.whyUz: Kun bilan ON: on Sunday, on Monday morning.

items.textEn: 2  "Where is Bournemouth?" "It's ____ the south coast of England."
items.whyUz: 'coast' bilan doim ON. Bournemouth — Angliyaning janubiy qirg'og'idagi shahar.

items.textEn: 3  What do you do ____ your free time?
4  She's quite tall ____ brown curly hair and brown eyes.
items.whyUz: Tashqi ko'rinish tavsifida WITH: tall WITH ... hair.

items.textEn: 5  We live ____ a big house near the city centre.
items.whyUz: Uy ichida yashash → IN a house.

items.textEn: 6  His mother is a teacher ____ a primary school.
items.whyUz: Maktab TURI aytilganda IN: a teacher IN a primary school.

items.textEn: 7  Do you like listening ____ rock music?
9  There are four ____ us ____ our family. (1-bo'shliq)
9  There are four of us ____ our family. (2-bo'shliq)
10  My house is ____ fifteen minutes' walk ____ the city centre. (1-bo'shliq)
10  My house is about fifteen minutes' walk ____ the city centre. (2-bo'shliq)
11  My father works ____ a very big company.
items.whyUz: 'work FOR a company' — kompaniyada ishlamoq. Turg'un birikma.

items.textEn: 12  His mother is a surgeon. She works ____ Memorial Hospital.
items.whyUz: Muassasa NOMI aytilganda AT: at Memorial Hospital.
Kun bilan ON. 'Sundays' ko'plikda — har yakshanba.

items.textEn: 14  He usually goes for a walk ____ his dog ____ the afternoon. (1-bo'shliq)
14  He usually goes for a walk with his dog ____ the afternoon. (2-bo'shliq)
items.whyUz: 'in the afternoon' — tushdan keyin. IN predlogi bilan.

items.textEn: 15  I live in Carlisle. It's a city ____ the north ____ England. (1-bo'shliq)
15  It's a city in the north ____ England. (2-bo'shliq)

exercises.instructionEn: Match the letters to the numbers to form sensible orders.
exercises.instructionUz: Harflarni raqamlarga moslab, ma'noli buyruq gaplar hosil qiling.
exercises.explanationUz:
Hammasi BUYRUQ gapi — fe'l bilan boshlanadi, ega yo'q.

MANTIQNI TOPING:
  Tidy ...      — nimani? → xona
  Go ...        — qayerga? → to bed
  Don't swim ...— qayerda? → here + sabab
  Bring me ...  — nimani? → suv
  Please, clean ... — nimani? → shkaflar
  Don't wake up ... — kimni? → chaqaloq
  Don't park ... — nimani, qayerda? → mashina, bu yerda
  Help ...      — kimga? → menga
  Please, don't smoke ... — qayerda? → bu yerda
  Don't stand up. Sit ... — qanday? → down

MULOYIMLIK: 'please' buyruq boshida ham, oxirida ham kelishi mumkin:
  PLEASE, clean the cupboards.
  Help me, PLEASE.

pairs.right: b  to bed. It's very late.
pairs.note: Yotishga bor. Juda kech. 'go TO bed' — 'the' YO'Q!

pairs.right: e  here, the water is dirty.
pairs.note: Bu yerda suzma, suv iflos. Inkor buyruq + sabab.
Menga suv olib kel. 'some water' — sanalmaydigan ot.
Mashinangni bu yerga qo'yma. 'park' — mashina qo'ymoq.
Menga yordam ber, iltimos. 'help' predlogsiz obyekt oladi.
Turmang. O'tiring, iltimos. Ikki qarama-qarshi buyruq.

exercises.instructionEn: First, look at the language key, then use the prompts to write sentences, as in the example. Remember, we use the -ing form after the verbs love, like, not like, hate.
exercises.instructionUz: Avval kalitga qarang, so'ng berilgan so'zlar bilan gap yozing. Esda tuting: love, like, not like, hate fe'llaridan keyin -ing shakli keladi.
exercises.explanationUz:
KALIT:
  ☺ katta tabassum — LOVE      (juda yaxshi ko'radi)
  ☺ oddiy tabassum — LIKE      (yoqtiradi)
  ☹ xafa yuz       — NOT LIKE  (yoqtirmaydi)
  ☹ jahldor yuz    — HATE      (yomon ko'radi)

IKKI QADAM:
  1) Fe'lni to'g'ri shaklga qo'ying:
     he/she/it → loveS, likeS, hateS / DOESN'T like
     I/you/we/they → love, like, hate / DON'T like

  2) IKKINCHI fe'lga -ING qo'shing:
     windsurf → windsurfING
     watch → watchING
     go → goING
     camp → campING
     listen → listenING
     play → playING

IMLO ESLATMASI:
  oxirida -e bo'lsa tushadi: have → having
  qisqa unli + undosh: swim → swimming, camp → camping
  (camp — ikkita undosh bilan tugaydi, ikkilanmaydi)

modelSentences.word: 2. Jenny and Chris — HATE / watch horror films
modelSentences.sentence: Jenny and Chris hate watching horror films.
modelSentences.uz: Jenni va Kris qo'rqinchli filmlarni ko'rishni yomon ko'radi.

modelSentences.word: 6. Janet — LOVE / listen to jazz music
modelSentences.sentence: Janet loves listening to jazz music.
modelSentences.uz: Janet jaz musiqa tinglashni juda yaxshi ko'radi.

exercises.explanationUz:
JAVOBGA QARAB SAVOLNI TIKLANG.

UCH XIL SAVOL TURI:

  1) DO/DOES bilan (oddiy fe'l):
     Does she like ...? — Yes, she does.
     Do you live ...?   — Yes, I do.

  2) 'to be' bilan (do/does KERAK EMAS):
     What's her mother like? — She's kind and patient.

  3) 'look like' bilan (DOES kerak):
     What does Mary look like? — She's beautiful.

IKKI SAVOLNI ADASHTIRMANG:
  What's X like?        → XARAKTER   (be fe'li)
  What does X look like? → KO'RINISH (do/does + look)

'What do you do?' — KASBNI so'raydi:
  What do you do? — I'm a student.
  (so'zma-so'z 'nima qilasan', lekin ma'nosi 'kasbing nima')

lines.textEn: Does she like walking in the park?

lines.whyUz: Javobda 'I' → savolda 'Do you'. Barselona — Ispaniya shahri.
'I' bilan 'do'.

lines.hintUz: KASB so'raladigan savol — ikkala bo'shliqda ham bir xil so'z
lines.whyUz: 'What DO you DO?' — kasbni so'raydi. Birinchi 'do' — yordamchi fe'l, ikkinchisi — asosiy fe'l.
'I'm a student' = I am a student. Kasb oldida 'a' shart.
Javob 'She's kind and patient' — xarakter. 'What's ... like?' = What IS ... like?
'She's' = She is. Ona — ayol.
'look like' bilan DOES kerak: What DOES Mary LOOK LIKE?

lines.textEn: ____ beautiful. She's got green eyes and black hair.
lines.whyUz: 'She's beautiful' = She is beautiful.
Javobda 'they' → savolda 'Do they'. 'like' dan keyin -ING: meeting.
Ko'plik → do.
Javobda 'she' → savolda 'Does she'.
'she' bilan inkor → doesn't.
Javobda 'they' → savolda 'Do they'.
Ko'plik inkor → don't.

groups.explanationUz: Ishlash haqida gapirganda uch xil predlog ishlatiladi.

items.derived: a teacher IN a primary school

groups.explanationUz: Ko'p fe'llarga shunchaki -ing qo'shiladi, lekin uchta istisno bor.
So'zma-so'z tarjima chalkash — ma'nosini butun holda yodlang.
Kundalik hayotda eng ko'p ishlatiladigan buyruqlar.

patterns.exampleEn: She likes him a lot. They don't like it at all.
patterns.exampleUz: U uni juda yoqtiradi. Ular uni umuman yoqtirmaydi.
patterns.explanationUz:
Fe'ldan oldin — ega, keyin — obyekt.
'a lot' = juda, 'not ... at all' = umuman ...emas.

patterns.exampleEn: She thinks he's interesting. They think it's terrible.
patterns.exampleUz: U uni qiziqarli deb o'ylaydi. Ular uni dahshatli deb o'ylaydi.
patterns.explanationUz:
'thinks' dan keyin YANGI gap boshlanadi —
shuning uchun u yerda ham EGA shakli keladi.

patterns.exampleEn: James loves windsurfing. They like camping.
patterns.exampleUz: Jeyms vindserfingni juda yaxshi ko'radi. Ular chodirda dam olishni yoqtiradi.
patterns.explanationUz: Bu fe'llardan keyin ikkinchi fe'l DOIM -ING oladi.

patterns.exampleEn: She doesn't like going fishing. We don't like playing football.
patterns.exampleUz: U baliq ovlashga borishni yoqtirmaydi. Biz futbol o'ynashni yoqtirmaymiz.
patterns.explanationUz: Inkorda 'like' asos shaklida, keyingi fe'l esa -ING da.

patterns.formula: What's X like? ↔ What does X look like?
patterns.exampleEn:
What's her mother like? — She's kind and patient.
What does Mary look like? — She's beautiful.
patterns.exampleUz:
Onasi qanday odam? — U mehribon va sabrli.
Meri qanday ko'rinadi? — U go'zal.
patterns.explanationUz:
Birinchisi XARAKTER ('be' fe'li — does kerak emas),
ikkinchisi KO'RINISH ('look like' — does kerak).

patterns.formula: What do you do? — I'm a + kasb.
patterns.exampleEn: What do you do? — I'm a student.
patterns.explanationUz:
'do' ikki marta: birinchisi yordamchi, ikkinchisi asosiy fe'l.
Javob 'to be' bilan beriladi.

patterns.formula: Buyruq: fe'l + davomi. / Don't + fe'l + davomi.
patterns.exampleEn: Tidy your room. Don't park your car here.
patterns.exampleUz: Xonangni yig'ishtir. Mashinangni bu yerga qo'yma.
patterns.explanationUz: 'please' boshida ham, oxirida ham kelishi mumkin.
